testcase.name: toolsFor(uiState) > always exposes the five base tools
toolsFor(uiState) > does not expose flag_conflict for a subject with no disagreement
toolsFor(uiState) > exposes flag_conflict once the open subject has a disagreement
toolsFor(uiState) > does NOT expose resolve_claim merely because a person is open
toolsFor(uiState) > exposes resolve_claim only while that conflict is on screen
toolsFor(uiState) > withdraws resolve_claim once the conflict is closed
toolsFor(uiState) > drops all three conditional tools on returning to the archive
